name: doubt-driven-development
title_zh: 每个关键决策先过一轮对抗式复审再落地
tagline_zh: 写生产代码、碰陌生库、动不可逆操作时，别再靠自信拍板。每次非平凡决定都拉一个全新上下文的杠精来挑刺。
tagline_en: Before any non-trivial call stands, get a fresh-context adversary to poke holes. Cheaper to verify now than to.
desc_en: Subjects every non-trivial decision to a fresh-context adversarial review before it stands. Use when correctness matters more than speed, when working in unfamiliar code, when stakes are high (production, security-sensitive logic, irreversible operations), or any time a confident output would be cheaper to verify now than to debug later.
why_zh: 不是自查，是强制换上下文重审——让确认偏差没机会扎根。专治那种'我写的我信'的盲区。
why_en: Forces a context-switched adversarial pass, starving confirmation bias. Kills the 'I wrote it, so it's fine' blind spot.
limit_zh: 只覆盖决策复审，不生成代码、不跑测试、不查依赖。若你只是写脚本或改注释，它不会触发；若你拒绝被质疑，它会拖慢你。
limit_en: Reviews decisions only—no codegen, no tests, no dep checks. Won't fire on trivial edits; slows you down if you hate being challenged.
